newsitem.title: GERMANY: Chirac to meet Kohl in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Chirac to meet Kohl in Paris.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl will hold the latest in their regular series of meetings over dinner in Paris on May 20, a Bonn chancellery spokesman said on Tuesday.

A French official source had said earlier that the two men made the appointment during a telephone conversation on Monday evening after Chirac had announced an early election to be held in two rounds on May 25 and June 1.

Chirac and Kohl, who hold talks roughly every six weeks, last met in Bonn on April 9. On that occasion both leaders reaffirmed their determination to launch the single European currency on time in January 1999.
